Neural superiority over classic cannot be claimed from this dataset

Many contact brackets are broad overview bounds
Clip preferences came from the classic editor and subsequent visual review

videos.annotation_method: Continuous source-image sweeps followed by 10-25 fps contact inspection. Development windows informed fixes. Original frozen source labels are retained locally; subsequent timing and completeness corrections are explicitly recorded per window. This is not a full-match test set. Physical stops are not labelled.
limitations: Contact-reviewed intervals only; source outside them is unknown
Used as neural validation, so no longer a neural final holdout
Twelve AI-reviewed editorial intervals; other boundaries remain unknown; not human approved
